steps.command:
ls -la /workspace /app 2>/dev/null
echo "---ALICE---"
cat /app/alice_calendar.ics 2>/dev/null || cat /workspace/alice_calendar.ics
echo "---BOB---"
cat /app/bob_calendar.ics 2>/dev/null || cat /workspace/bob_calendar.ics
echo "---CAROL---"
cat /app/carol_calendar.ics 2>/dev/null || cat /workspace/carol_calendar.ics

sbx put /app/meeting_scheduled.ics <<'EOF'
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//MOCA Scheduling//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-meeting-20240117@example.com
DTSTAMP:20240115T090000Z
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:One-hour planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol.
LOCATION:Conference Room
ATTENDEE:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE:mailto:carol@example.com
STATUS:CONFIRMED
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
echo "=== verify file ==="
sbx run <<'EOF'
echo "--- first/last lines ---"
head -1 /app/meeting_scheduled.ics
tail -1 /app/meeting_scheduled.ics
echo "--- header/event checks ---"
grep -E 'VERSION:2.0|PRODID|BEGIN:VEVENT|END:VEVENT|DTSTART|DTEND|SUMMARY|ATTENDEE' /app/meeting_scheduled.ics
echo "--- input files unchanged? checksums ---"
md5sum /app/alice_calendar.ics /app/bob_calendar.ics /app/carol_calendar.ics
echo "--- revalidate output slot against calendars ---"
python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime
def parse(p):
    ev=[];cur=None
    for l in open(p):
        l=l.strip()
        if l=='BEGIN:VEVENT':cur={}
        elif l=='END:VEVENT':ev.append(cur);cur=None
        elif cur is not None and ':' in l:
            k,v=l.split(':',1);cur[k]=v
    return [(datetime.strptime(e['DTSTART'],'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'),datetime.strptime(e['DTEND'],'%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')) for e in ev]
s=datetime(2024,1,17,11,0); e=datetime(2024,1,17,12,0)
for name,p in [('alice','/app/alice_calendar.ics'),('bob','/app/bob_calendar.ics'),('carol','/app/carol_calendar.ics')]:
    conf=[(a,b) for a,b in parse(p) if s<b and e>a]
    print(name,'conflicts:',conf)
print('slot:',s,'-',e)
PY
EOF
